posts.title: Excursion around Foulness Island (15 miles)
posts.description: I have cycled to the gates of the MOD weapons testing ranges on Foulness Island. Also, as documented in my companion blog, "Walk Geography" https://walk-geography.blogspot.com/ , I have also looked across to the Island on my walks along the Crouch at Burnham-on-Sea, and around Wallasea Island . posts.description: On Hay Bluff [I put this walk here to highlight my companion blog "Walk Geography" at https://walk-geography.blogspot.com/ .] Over the weekend, I did two walks in the Black Mountains of South Wales.
